title: Add agency service-fee statement evidence
description: Add agency service-fee statement evidence linked to ERP-069 agreements and explicit existing service records. Statements capture disclosed repository evidence and remain separate from legal tax invoices, salesperson commission and general-ledger entries. Do not infer service links or fee amounts, issue an invoice, contact a customer, collect funds, post accounting, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized users can create and edit draft service-fee statement evidence for one authoritative Customer and currency with statement number, statement date, optional explicit due date, service period, bounded notes and one or more explicit lines.

Each line uses a persisted identifier to reference an eligible existing Sales Order, container shipment or another documented supported service source; text, amount or date similarity is never used to guess a link.

The server validates Customer and currency compatibility between the statement, ERP-069 agreement and every linked source; incompatible or unavailable active sources are rejected while bounded historical snapshots remain readable.

Line descriptions, quantities or basis snapshots and amounts are explicit persisted evidence supplied by an authorized user or copied from documented authoritative fields; no current agreement rate, default or free text is silently converted into a charge.
Statement totals are calculated server-side from validated lines using documented currency precision, and client-supplied totals are not trusted.
A service source may only be included under a documented uniqueness rule; duplicate links within a statement and duplicate active charging evidence are rejected rather than merged.
An optional due date is persisted evidence; when absent it remains unknown and is not calculated from Customer defaults, agreement prose or statement date at read time.

Draft statements can be recorded and later voided with a bounded reason while preserving lines, source and Customer snapshots, amounts and history; recorded or voided evidence cannot be silently replaced or hard-deleted.
The workflow labels statements as operational fee evidence, not a tax invoice, legal Customer statement, revenue recognition, payment demand, settlement confirmation or general-ledger posting.

Creating, recording, reading or voiding a statement does not mutate agreements, Customers, orders, containers, invoices, receipts, balances, tax, finance or settlement records and does not contact external services.
Schema changes are idempotent, queries are bounded or paged and avoid per-row access, and legacy sources remain readable without request-time or production backfill.

Unit and integration tests cover explicit source links, Customer and currency mismatch, duplicate charging protection, amount precision, unknown due date, record and void history, model separation, bounded queries and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is deferred during development.

scenarios: Create a draft agency service-fee statement from explicit compatible service records, verify server-calculated currency totals and an optional due date, then record it without changing source orders or containers or issuing an invoice.
Attempt duplicate, Customer-mismatched and currency-mismatched source links, verify rejection, then void valid recorded evidence and confirm its source snapshots, amounts and history remain readable.

human_gate.reason: Repository statement evidence over explicit non-production records only. Legal invoicing, Customer contact, real collection, accounting posting, production database mutation, deployment and release remain behind mandatory human gates.
